title: Extreme-dry storage-tail interpretation
AHL_design_implication: Do not interpret 1e-13 as a physical constitutive cutoff.
Do not spend adaptive support density resolving negligible extreme-dry storage response merely to reduce relative C error.
Any finite dry-tail representation boundary or regularized tail policy must be prospectively qualified against authoritative theta, flux, solver trajectory and mass balance.
Outside a qualified lookup domain, authoritative analytical fallback remains admissible.
